audit_scope: Comprehensive Frontend, Runtime, Rate-Limiting, Docker, and Production Readiness Audit

skills.name: ui-review
skills.justification: Ensures design token compliance, visual consistency, alignment, spacing hierarchy, control sizing, and avoids AI-cliche design tropes.

skills.name: ui-a11y
skills.justification: Audits WCAG AA compliance, touch targets, keyboard navigation (ESC, focus rings), aria labels, and prefers-reduced-motion.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.justification: Ensures the UI feels clean, compact, readable, responsive across 600px-1920px viewports, and maintains strong information hierarchy.

skills.name: code-reviewer
skills.justification: Static analysis, data model integrity, risk scoring consistency, error boundaries, and production reliability.

skills.name: react-component-performance
skills.justification: Audits unnecessary re-renders, expensive sorting/filtering on 2000+ games, memoization, and chart performance.

skills.name: performance-engineer
skills.justification: Audits SQLite performance, sync queue concurrency, background tasks, memory footprint, and network latency.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.justification: Diagnoses console warnings, failed requests, stale states, modal scrolling, and edge case bugs.

skills.name: security-auditor
skills.justification: Audits Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, Portainer compatibility, env variables, healthcheck, and storage persistence.

skills.name: api-patterns
skills.justification: Audits duplicate requests, payload sizing, caching, HTTP 429/500/404 handling, and rate limit backoff.
